breakingChanges.summary: Change bare agent-route --agent-envelope output from the generic full envelope to the bounded proofkit.agent-route.brief packet.
Raise published Darwin package compatibility to macOS 13.0 so wheel tags remain truthful for binaries built with Go 1.27.1.

additions.summary: Add --agent-envelope-mode brief|full so agents can request bounded default guidance or the complete generic envelope explicitly.
Update the verified build and CI baseline to Go 1.27.1 with Unicode 17.0.0, Node 26.8.1, npm 12.0.2, Python 3.14.7, and the current stable repository-owned dependency and action pins.

steps: Consumers that require the former generic agent-route envelope must add --agent-envelope-mode full after --agent-envelope; consumers that accept bounded route guidance may keep bare --agent-envelope.
Darwin consumers must use macOS 13.0 or later; contributors that build from source must use Go 1.27.1.

platformRequirements: Published Darwin package binaries require macOS 13.0 or later on arm64 and x86_64.
knownLimitations: Agent workflow plans, prompts, text, and envelopes are derived guidance and do not execute agents, repository mutations, native witnesses, CI, release, rollout, or production operations.
Brief agent-route packets cap pretty JSON at 3072 bytes and may defer oversized argv to explicit full detail; the bound does not claim tokenizer-specific token counts.
Complete nested public structural contracts remain blocked under SCHEMA-01; current CLI contracts own exact root variants only.
The selected requirement-source v2 codec remains internal; current requirement sources are not migrated and no source cutover is claimed.
